observations.contract: Terrain contact identity and failed activation
observations.trace: RetainedTreePresentations::activate compares the active contact scene_digest with the environment digest and returns immediately on equality, without inspecting terrain. Otherwise it can restore one of two retained scenes by digest. If no match exists it first builds TerrainContactHeightmap::from_terrain(terrain) with ?; only after success does it take the active cache and diagnostics. A restored plant variant rebinds bark to the destination terrain. The pending tree presenter passes the active entity environment and terrain and returns on activation error.
observations.remaining: The source trace supports preservation of the active cache on a failed fresh heightmap construction, not a runtime result. Equal digest with changed terrain is a conditional identity question: no supported producer, stale image or mismatch was shown. Trace all producers, component changes, image/asset lifetime and scene-switch scheduling.

observations.trace: TacticalSceneInput::digest validates the input then hashes its JSON bytes with SHA-256 into a String. On the inspected normal server path input.generate() uses default building recipes, obtains generated terrain and generated digest, and supplies that digest to environment_snapshot; spawn_scene inserts the environment and generated terrain into one scene. The public generate_unfurnished API also accepts GeneratedBuildingRecipes, which participates in preparing buildings and geographic reservations, ground and refined terrain. SceneEnvironment is an immutable Bevy component with public fields; SceneTerrain has private fields, serde admission and is a component without that immutable annotation.
observations.remaining: These bounded sources do not prove a same-digest/different-terrain pair is supported or impossible, nor that all independent, fixture, replicated or mutated scenes share the normal path. No hash, terrain, asset or scene was generated.

observations.contract: Typed preparation errors and browser encoding
observations.trace: The full shared PreparationError has typed serde JSON, CBOR, scene, building, geometry, vista and interior causes and a GraphicsConfiguration variant retaining a message String. The regional city preparation source maps the graphics parser message to that typed outer variant; the existing graphics error-ownership finding records the upstream loss of typed cause. wasm_error converts the typed error to a JavaScript Error message and its code to name at the external boundary. PresentationOwner separately names two typed slots and projects them to native RenderLayers.
observations.remaining: The outer variant and native text boundary do not by themselves prove private prose dispatch. All preparation producers, error consumers, parser cause policy and aliases remain open; no browser or product code ran.
